product.name: 4K60 2X2 Video Wall Controller with HDMI Plus IR Control and RS232 Support
product.description: Ultra‑Flexible 4K60 Video Wall Controller with Multi‑Input, Audio Extraction, and Versatile Layout OptionsCreate stunning video wall displays utilizing up to 4 screens in various configurations from either HDMI or USB‑C equipped sourcesVersatile Display Solutions for Multi‑Screen EnvironmentsExperience the ultimate in display flexibility with this advanced video wall controller, designed to seamlessly distribute one HDMI® or USB‑C® source‑such as a Blu‑ray player, computer, laptop, media player, or gaming console‑across up to four screens at once. Supporting a range of display configurations including 2x2, 1x2, 2x1, 1x3, 3x1, 1x4, and 4x1, this device ensures your visuals are as dynamic as your needs. The controller boasts multiple input (x2) and output (x4) options, with support for resolutions up to 4K@60Hz and various formats such as 1024x768, 720p, and 1080p. Advanced features include bezel adjustment for seamless screen edges, image rotation up to 180°‑perfect for ceiling installations‑and comprehensive EDID® management for optimal compatibility.Enjoy effortless audio extraction with both optical (S/PDIF) and analog (RCA) outputs, with support for LPCM, Dolby Digital, and DTS formats. The controller is easy to operate using front panel buttons, an IR remote, or RS‑232 commands, making it suitable for both professional and casual users. Control is intuitive, and installation is truly plug‑and‑play‑no additional drivers or complex setup required.
